title: Factory Production Orders: Acknowledgment Return Window, Production Queue and Template Requirement by Class
content:
For Factory Production Orders, after an order is entered the homeowner signs and returns the order acknowledgment, and the plant then queues the order for production. The class figures are:

| Build class | Acknowledgment return window (business days after order entry) | Production queue (business days) | Full-size template of each opening required before production |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 3 | 3 | No |
| Custom Color Build | 3 | 3 | No |
| Specialty Glass Build | 3 | 5 | No |
| Specialty Shape Build | 3 | 5 | Yes |
| Impact-Rated Build | 3 | 5 | No |
| Architectural Wood Build | 3 | 7 | No |

Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.

## Terms used in the table

- **Acknowledgment return window** — the business days after the order entry date within which the customer signs and returns the order acknowledgment.
- **Production queue** — the business days from the signed acknowledgment (and the template, where one is required) to the start of production.
- **Template requirement** — whether a full-size template of each opening must be received at the factory before production can start. Only the Specialty Shape Build class requires it.

## Late-acknowledgment shift basis

Every class carries the same late-acknowledgment shift basis, **business days late**: a late acknowledgment moves the current ship date later by the number of business days the signature came after the return window. This basis names the standard count only; it does not by itself settle the whole shift recorded when an acknowledgment comes in late.

## Points of reading

- The return window is the same 3 business days in every class; the queue differs by class.
- For a Specialty Shape Build order the queue runs from the later of the signed acknowledgment and the template's receipt; for every other class it runs from the signed acknowledgment.
